svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear cross member 610 long between the rails, 332.5 ahead of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear axle line, centre at axle height (333.5 up).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearers 2 x 837.5 long, 300 apart centre to centre, top faces 150

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the ground (125 mm ground clearance underneath).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hangers: rear 2 x 171 under the rear cross member, front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 x 164 under the front lower cross member, all 150 out from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line, standing on the bearer ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the hangers to the bearers first (a ladder upside down),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then offer it up under the cross members and weld the tops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 6.6 mm holes through the bearers for the cradle bolts:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 400 and 1,080 ahead of the rear axle line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bearer tops level within 2 mm and 300 apart; cradle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drops in with 5 mm to spare in front of the hangers.
